messages:
mina.new: Quick question \u2014 first week onboarding. Need Vault read access for my microservice (staging). Who do I ask and is there a simple template?

alex.devex: Welcome Mina! Paste this into #platform-requests and tag the service owner + security for prod.

sam.security: For staging we can approve via infra ticket; for prod I need a PM or eng lead as approver. Rotation policy: prefer dynamic DB creds, otherwise 90d rotation for static secrets.

alex.devex: Template to paste:
```
secret_request:
  requester: mina.new
  service: telemetry-agent
  envs: [staging]
  vault_paths:
    - secret/data/telemetry-agent/staging: read
  approver: @sam.security
  reason: app needs DB creds for integration tests
```

infra-bot: Ticket PR-1287 created. ETA staging: 1 business day.

vault-bot: policy "svc-telemetry-agent-staging" created (audit id: c3f2).

mina.new: Thanks! If I get "permission denied" after policy attach who should I ping?

alex.devex: Ping me or @infra-ops with the exact error and the curl/SDK call. We'll check policy binding and service identity.

sam.security: Also: don't request wildcard paths and avoid committing secrets to repos. Happy to run a 10-min walkthrough if helpful.
